name: 0th-skills
description: Provider-neutral workflow skills for engineering and research agents.

interface.shortDescription: Portable build, debug, research, and ship workflows
interface.longDescription: Use 0th to turn ideas into decisions, select the smallest coordination artifact, build with TDD, debug from root cause, run source-aware research, and ship with explicit evidence. Runtime profiles bind host tools, state, and topology without placing provider choices in shared skills. Includes Codex integration and Claude Code compatibility.
